Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the B2B Marketing Manager position at Management Centre Europe. With a strong foundation in SEO, GEO, and hands-on digital marketing, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to MCE's growth and modernize its demand generation in an AI-driven landscape.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to implement structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am comfortable with tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and I actively use AI tools to enhance content creation and campaign workflows.

I am particularly drawn to MCE's focus on AI search and answer engines, and I am eager to bring my practical experience and curiosity to your team. I am based in Belgium and available for remote work within EMEA.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to MCE's success.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the B2B Marketing Manager position at Management Centre Europe. As a digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, GEO, and web development, I am passionate about helping organizations be found, understood, and chosen in today's evolving search landscape. MCE's commitment to developing managers across EMEA and its forward-thinking approach to AI-driven marketing resonate deeply with my skills and career aspirations.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation, directly contributing to improved organic visibility for client websites. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring they are fast, user-friendly, and optimized for search engines. My hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs allows me to make data-driven decisions and continuously refine strategies.

What sets me apart is my proactive exploration of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity. I have conducted iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably improving the site's search-health score. This practical experience aligns perfectly with MCE's goal of optimizing for AI-driven discovery.

I am a hands-on, strategic thinker who thrives in dynamic environments. I am eager to bring my expertise in SEO, content, and AI tools to MCE, helping to modernize demand generation and build a strong digital presence. I am based in Belgium and available for remote work within EMEA.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to MCE's continued growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
